title: Paradox Engineering
description: Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

puzzle.goal: In the free group on k generators every element is a unique reduced word: no letter is ever followed by its own inverse. The first letter has 2k choices and each later letter 2k − 1. Count all elements of word length at most N, including the empty word.
puzzle.name: Word-ball count in a free group (the engine of the Banach–Tarski paradox)
puzzle.ask: Summing the geometric series gives 1 + 2k((2k−1)^N − 1)/(2k − 2). Find how many elements of the free group on two generators have length at most 5.

vars.B: ball of words around the identity

puzzle.method: Count reduced words of exact length n by choosing letters one at a time, forbidding the inverse of the previous letter; then add up the lengths.
